lines: A live race now shares one board: positions and gaps for every rider, every second, from the service.
The board is the service's: every rider by place, you in fifth, each gap to you, seven seconds up to five behind.
Each second the race sends your distance and power to the session, never more than twice a second.
The service rides the bots on the pace model, ranks by distance, and times each gap from the leader's trace.
The board joins at tablet width and up; on a phone the race keeps your place beside the power.
What the tests prove: one ranking for everyone, each gap to you, and reports at most twice a second.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
